Live Document: architecture.md

Architecture Draft

This document is actively being written by the Architect Reviewer subagent based on our conversation...

1. Framework Choice

The system is architected as a native desktop application using Rust. The frontend leverages the Slint UI framework instead of Iced or React to provide a fluid, premium desktop experience with declarative, easily maintained component definitions.

2. Multi-Agent Data Flow

graph TD;
A[Slint UI Components] -->|MPSC Channels| B(Rust Orchestrator Core);
B --> C{Redb Persistence Layer};
B --> D[Agent Task Queue];
D --> E((Cursor Provider));
D --> F((Claude Provider));
E --> C;
F --> C;

3. State Management

State is entirely event-sourced through the Orchestrator loop. Planning state transitions move through PRD intake, PlanUnit drafting, node-readiness, and handoff stages so compile progress stays resumable and deterministic.

4. Persistence Strategy

Data persistence relies on redb (an embedded key-value store in Rust) and the standard file system. File system interactions are strictly guarded by the FileSafe verification gates to prevent accidental overwrites during autonomous execution.

Product Requirements Document

Status: Approved | Version: 1.0

1. Executive Summary

Puppet Master is a cross-platform desktop IDE designed to orchestrate AI agents for automated coding. It leverages Rust and Slint for a highly responsive user experience.

2. Functional Requirements

  • FR1: The system shall support PRD Builder intake, Planning Wizard refinement, and Plan Compile handoff state.
  • FR2: It must integrate natively with multiple providers: Cursor, Gemini, Codex, Claude Code, Copilot.
  • FR3: Orchestrator must project Plan Compile progress before any later runtime handoff.
  • FR4: The Planning Wizard must capture requirements and preserve source refs for PlanUnits.

3. Non-Functional Requirements

  • NFR1: Native performance with application launch time under 500ms.
  • NFR2: The UI framework must be based on Slint for declarative performance.
  • NFR3: Agent memory scaling must not exceed token quotas (budget caps must be supported).

4. Multi-Pass Review Process

The system integrates document validation and canonical alignment so PRD state can be compiled into PlanUnits before implementation work is dispatched.

5. Out of Scope

Mobile application and cloud deployment orchestration are deferred to version 2.0.

Plan Compile State

Stage: PRD Intake

Surface: PRD Builder

- Normalize requirements intake.
- Preserve accepted constraints, source refs, and out-of-scope notes.
- Prepare the Planning Wizard ledger snapshot.

Stage: PlanUnits

Surface: Planning Wizard

- Draft stable PlanUnits from accepted planning state.
- Carry dependency, risk, validation, and GUI-routing metadata.
- Preserve source refs for compile traceability.

Stage: Node Readiness

Surface: Plan Compile

- Produce node-readiness metadata only.
- Use the accepted PNC-007 compiler contract as the runtime-readiness boundary while this concept fixture remains non-emitting.
- Project compile progress into Orchestrator without making it scheduler truth.

Stage: Orchestrator Handoff

Surface: Orchestrator Plan Compile

- Publish the approved compile state for later handoff.
- Materialize runtime artifacts only through compiler, Executor intake, activation, and Goal Runtime certification contracts.
